import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_MASK = (1 << 18);
    static final int N = (1 << 20);
    static double[] p = new double[6][6];
    static long[] F = new long[N];

    static long ans = 0;
    static long[][] pArr = new long[6][6];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static long modPow(long x, long y) {
        long z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1)
                z = (z * x) % MOD;
            x = (x * x) % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {

        }
        for (int i = n; i < 6; ++i)

                p[i][j] = 1;

        List<int[]> E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});

        int nump = 0;
        Arrays.fill(m, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; ++j)
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; ++k) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    v.add(i);
                    v.add(j);
                    v.add(k);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3)) ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1)) ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask)
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1)
                                m[mask] |= (1L << nump);
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    nump++;
                }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
            double v = 1.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; ++i) {
                int fi = E.get(i)[0];
                int si = E.get(i)[1];
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    v = (v * p[fi][si]) % MOD;
                } else {
                    v = (v * (1 - p[fi][si] + MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            F[(int)m[mask]] = (F[(int)m[mask]] + (long)(v * 1.0 + 0.5)) % MOD; // Multiply by probability
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i)
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask)
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1)
                    F[mask] = (F[mask] + F[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;

        Arrays.fill(m, 0);
        nump = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; ++j)
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; ++k) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < 6; ++ii)
                        if (ii != i && ii != j && ii != k)
                            v.add(ii);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3)) ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1)) ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask)
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1)

                    } while (nextPermutation(v));

                }

            long val = (long)(v * 1.0 + 0.5);
            long subF = F[(int)comp];
            long tmp = ((1 - subF + MOD) % MOD);
            long prod = (val * tmp) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + prod) % MOD;

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1))
            i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i))
            j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }
